properties.displayName: mac4azure: VMs must carry governance tags (maintenance-window, owner, workload)
properties.description: A change process needs to know when a VM may be touched, who owns it, and what kind of workload it runs. Audits (or denies) VMs missing any of the tags maintenance-window, owner, workload.

metadata.description: Audit reports; Deny blocks creation of VMs without the tags.
